objective: Close phase-review checkpoint findings by reconstructing person/episode lifecycle state from event history and requiring exact ED adapter mapping coverage.
steps: Replay every identity event in canonical tick/command order through a temporary ledger and reject checkpoints where derived people, episodes, relationships, births, statuses, exits, counts or watermark differ from stored state.
Reject duplicate exit/death lifecycle events and state changes without corresponding events; retain same-tick exit-before-death semantics.
Require ED adapter person/admission maps to cover exactly all people and episodes in its internal IdentityLedger, in addition to checking each derived key and event.
Add JSON checkpoint tampering regressions for unlogged death, unlogged exit, duplicate exit, duplicate death where practical, and omitted ED mapping maps.
Run focused core/ED tests and formatting; then repeat the full A5.4 workspace and Conductor verification packet and obtain reviewer-agent re-review.

verification.oracle: Core restore rejects lifecycle tampering and duplicate terminal events while valid roundtrip/suffix cases pass.
ED restore rejects omitted identity maps while valid mapped checkpoint roundtrips pass.

acceptance: Identity checkpoint snapshots and lifecycle accounting are exactly derivable from valid event history in canonical order.
Every accepted exit/death has one valid transition event; missing or repeated transitions reject on restore.
ED adapter maps exactly cover every person and episode in its private core ledger, with source/admission keys and derived IDs still validated.
A5.4's existing full-workspace checks and independent phase review are rerun at the fixed commit before acceptance.
No changes to Kairos source/pin, ED external schema or domain behavior are introduced.
stop_conditions: Reconstructed event history changes accepted current valid behavior
Existing transfer re-export or serialized public identity IDs change
ED map coverage cannot be enforced without changing ED schema
Kairos or profile edit is required
